item.title: Fifa staff asked to attend interviews as Infantino sell-off scheme investigated
item.description:
• Democrats to examine Fifa Forward Enterprise scandal

  • Infantino could be subpoenaed to give evidence

A number of past and present Fifa employees have received letters requesting they attend interviews for a congressional investigation into the global governing body sparked by the Fifa Forward Enterprise scandal.

Letters were sent on Wednesday to a number of staff along with a handful of former employees who held senior positions. They have been asked by Democrats on the House judiciary committee to give evidence as efforts gather pace to examine Gianni Infantino’s failed FFE scheme along with links between Fifa and the Trump administration.

item.title: Campbell Wright becomes first American to win World Cup biathlon event
item.description:
• Wright delivers ‘best performance’ in Kontiolahti, Finland

  • 24-year-old was actually born in New Zealand

Campbell Wright made history on Thursday by becoming the first American to win a World Cup biathlon event.

The 24-year-old was flawless at the shooting range in the World Cup opener in Kontiolahti, Finland and triumphed in the 20km individual race in 24 minutes and 29.8 seconds. Germany’s Justus Strelow finished 1:20 behind and Norway’s Vetle Sjaastad Christiansen was 1:23 adrift in third. Christiansen’s teammate, and last year’s World Cup overall champion, Sturla Holm Laegreid had to settle for fourth.

item.title: Trump alleges ‘fake’ economic figures released before US midterms but doesn’t provide evidence
item.description:
In a Thanksgiving post, the US president seeks investigation after blue wave of Democrats unseat Republicans

Donald Trump has alleged without evidence that economic figures published by the US federal government before this month’s midterm elections were “fake” and demanded an investigation after voters roundly rejected his Republican party.

In a holiday message on social media tinged with bitterness, the US president wished a happy thanksgiving “to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%”.
